monte_carlo.degradation_uncertainty_source: robust cross-stint slope spread (1.4826 × median absolute deviation), using plausible slopes from 0.002 to 0.20 s/lap and at least three historical stints per compound
monte_carlo.assumptions: weather scenario sampled by heuristic weights; per-lap model errors treated as independent normal residuals; degradation slope error uses a robust spread estimate from plausible historical cross-stint slopes
